record_scope_reconstruction: Haitian-side passenger restrictions cover four official land posts: Malpasse,Jimaní counterpart; Belladère,EliasPiña counterpart; Ouanaminthe,Dajabón counterpart; and Anse-à-Pitres,Pedernales counterpart. Goods with reduced crews were exempt; Haitian June reopening does not imply Dominican market reopening.

source_checks.finding: March16 report attributes announcement to prime minister, effective midnight, excluding merchandise with reduced crews.
July1 VOA original explicitly names all four crossings reopened TuesdayJune30. Airport restrictions are separately described.
Raw official directory inspected; lists Malpasse,Belladere,Ouanaminthe andAnse-a-Pitre customs offices, but no usable coordinates recovered.
Named Haitian customs border node next to Malpasse immigration and police, distinct from Dominican control1km southeast and settlement centroid.
Previously inspected Dajabón customs geographic reference identifies opposite side of Ouanaminthe route, not Haitian restriction gate.
